title: ChemInform Abstract: Disproportionation Reactions of the Dimeric Allyliron Compound (η3‐C3H5Fe(CO)3)2; Formation of Novel Cationic η3‐Allylironcarbonyl Complexes.
abstract: AbstractThe metal‐metal bonded title dimer (I) disproportionates on treatment with the tert.‐phosphines (II) forming the ionic allyl‐Fe complexes (III).
